# Definition
The ***transpose*** $A^\top$ of an $m \times n$ matrix $A$ is the $n \times m$ matrix obtained from $A$ by interchanging the rows with the columns, i.e., $(A^\top)_{ij} = A_{ji}$.

# Theorem
**(i)** $(aA+bB)^\top = aA^\top + bB^\top$ for any $A, B \in F^{m \times n}$ and any $a, b\in F$. 

**(ii)** $(A^\top)^\top = A$ for each $A \in F^{m \times n}$.

**(iii)** $(A_1A_2 \cdots A_k)^\top = A_k^\top \cdots A_2^\top A_1^\top$ for any $A_1, A_2, \dots, A_k \in F^{n \times n}$ and any $k \in \mathbb{N}$.

# Reference
- S. H. Friedberg, A. J. Insel, and L. E. Spence, Linear Algebra, 4th ed. (Pearson New International Edition), Pearson, 2013.
